params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by a supported field. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

params.name: task_status_id
params.description: Opaque Task status ID with the `taskstatus_` prefix.

params.name: assignee_id
params.description: Opaque user ID with the `user_` prefix.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Filter to a specific related entity type.

params.name: entity_id
params.description: Filter to one specific related entity. Requires `entity_type`.

params.name: due_before
params.description: Return only Tasks due on or before this ISO 8601 date.

params.name: due_after
params.description: Return only Tasks due on or after this ISO 8601 date.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Return only records created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Return only records created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return only records updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return only records updated before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: overdue
params.description: When true, return only Tasks past their due date and not in a done status.

items.docs: Return a paginated list of Tasks. Filter by `task_status_id`, `assignee_id`, and `entity_type` + `entity_id` together (to scope to one CRM record), plus `due_before`/`due_after` and created/updated timestamp windows. Pass `overdue=true` to limit results to Tasks past their due date and not in a completed status. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`.

Create a new Task. Resolve the Task status by passing exactly one of `task_status_id` (a `taskstatus_` ID) or `task_status_name` (looked up case-insensitively among the organization's Task Statuses). To link the Task to a CRM record, pass `entity_type` and `entity_id` together.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Opaque Task ID with the `task_` prefix.

items.docs: Return a single Task by its `task_` ID with full detail, including the assignee, linked entity (when set), and resolved Task status.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Opaque Task ID with the `task_` prefix.

items.docs: Partially update a Task by ID. `title`, `task_status_id`, and `task_status_name` are non-nullable — they cannot be cleared. When changing the status, pass either `task_status_id` or `task_status_name`, not both.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Opaque Task ID with the `task_` prefix.
